title: Discounted Price
statement: Write a function `discountedPrice(originalPrice, discount)` that returns the price after subtracting the discount.
prewrittenHints: A discount reduces the price. Which operator takes away one number from another?
Take the discount away from the first price parameter.
Return the starting price minus the discount amount.
conceptNote: Subtractive operations use the minus operator. Be sure the first value is the starting price.
